taRule: Long if SMA20 of finalized daily closes is strictly greater than SMA50; cash on equality. Require the latest 50 consecutive daily candles through the previous UTC day.
lunarRule: TA long is permitted only when pinned-engine Moon-minus-Sun elongation at the future execution midnight is within 12 degrees of new or full phase. Otherwise cash. This arbitrary fixed filter has not been optimized for historical profit.
execution: Decision is recorded on the previous UTC day, at least 15 minutes before execution. Each long arm buys at the next UTC daily open with adverse slippage and sells at that daily close with adverse slippage. Each side pays the same fee. Daily trades are independent round trips, not a continuous SMA crossover portfolio. Cash earns zero interest. No leverage, shorts, fills, or orders are sent to an exchange.
dataPolicy: Reject future, unfinished, duplicate-conflicting, missing or malformed feature/settlement candles. Never fill missing days. Raw vendor responses and individual decisions remain outside the checkout. Late or missed decisions cannot be backfilled and remain visible in coverage.
primaryMetric: TA+lunar minus TA-only terminal net return, reported separately for BTC and ETH after the fixed 180-day window.
stoppingRule: No early efficacy decision or parameter changes. Interim output is descriptive only. Missing days remain cash for both arms and are explicitly reported. No pooled independent-asset claim because BTC and ETH are correlated.
inference: No significance, profitability or predictive-benefit claim from this pilot alone. Daily equity drawdown does not measure intraday drawdown. Fixed simulated costs are assumptions, not verified executions.
timestampLimit: Local recordedAt and write-once hashed receipts detect accidental edits; they are not independent timestamp attestation. Independent prospective decision witnessing and persistent scheduled storage must be arranged before treating this as externally verifiable evidence.
